scenarios.name: Filter the model browser by a feature name

scenario_steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion named Extrusion1
the model browser shows its normal hierarchy
the user opens browser search and enters "Extrusion"
the browser shows matching extrusion rows and their ancestor hierarchy
unrelated origin rows are absent from the filtered tree
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clears the search text
